$comment: eApps R8 (VAPP-233, docs/spec/apps.md §3.6/§2.3): declarative record migrations between package versions. TS reference src/host/record-migrations.ts, Rust twin eui-core `host::record_migrations` (the FFI's `migrate_record_json` / `migration_refusal_json` for the Swift and Compose SDKs); the Exponential server sweeps an app's records through them on publish and refuses an uncovered incompatible major bump at upsert. Inputs hand-written, `expected` filled by scripts/generate-host.ts. RANGES (`rangeCases`: rangeHolds(version, range), isVersionRange(range)): a version is MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH; a range is alternatives split by `||`, each space-separated comparators that must all hold: an exact or partial version (`1.2.3`, `1.2`, `1.x`, `1`, `*`; `x`/`*` any part, `=` optional), `>= > <= <` v, `~v` (same major.minor, not lower), `^v` (the same leftmost non-zero part, not lower; `^0.0.3` = exactly 0.0.3); after an operator v is numeric with missing parts = 0 (`^1` = `^1.0.0`, `>=1.2` = `>=1.2.0`; `>=1.x` is no range). Anything else is no range (holds nothing). MIGRATE (`migrateCases`: migrateRecord(package.migrations, version, kind, data, now = 0)): in order, every migration whose `from` holds `version` and whose `kind` is the record's kind AT THAT STEP (a `renameKind` moves the later migrations to the new kind) runs its ops in order: `rename {from, to}` moves a present field (the target overwritten; absent = nothing); `default {field, value}` sets a missing or null field; `drop {field}` removes it; `map {field, expr}` writes a CEL expression (expressions.json) over the record's fields (a name the record lacks reads null) into the field; an evaluation error = {error: `migration <i> op <j>: <message>`} and the record is left as it was; `renameKind <kind>`. Result {kind, data, applied (migrations that ran)}. VALIDATE (`validateCases`: validateMigrations(package)): issues under `/migrations`: a list of at most `limits.migrations`, each {from, kind, ops} (an unknown key named), `from` a range, `kind` a kind name, `ops` a list of at most `limits.ops`, each exactly one of rename {from, to}, default {field, value}, drop {field}, map {field, expr} (the expression parses: `/ops/<j>/map/expr`), renameKind <kind name>; the kind the migration ends in (after renameKind) is declared in `records`. CHANGES (`changeCases`: kindChanges(before, after)): per kind of `before` (code-unit order): `removed` (no such kind after), then per field of before: `drops` (gone), `retypes` (type changed; an array's item type counts), `narrows` (the enum lost a value, or gained one where there was none), then `requires` (required after, not before, the field present after). An added optional field or kind is compatible. REFUSAL (`refusalCases`: migrationRefusal(before, after)): null unless after.version's MAJOR is above before.version's; then the first uncovered change (kinds, then changes in order) = `<kind> <is removed | drops f | changes the type of f | narrows the values of f | requires f> in <after.version>: add a migration from <before.version> that covers it`. A change is covered by an op of a migration from before.version for that kind: removed = renameKind; drops = drop or a rename from the field; retypes / narrows = a map of the field; requires = a default, a map or a rename to the field.
